name: Indiana University Bloomington
academic_ranking: Indiana University Bloomington is a large public flagship research university (R1) and a founding member of the Big Ten Conference. It is regarded as a strong national public university, well known for its Kelley School of Business, Jacobs School of Music, and programs in public affairs, informatics, and the sciences.
financial_aid: Tuition figure shown is 2026-27 full-time in-state (Indiana resident) tuition and mandatory fees (approx. $12,142). Non-resident tuition and mandatory fees are approx. $42,702; estimated total cost of attendance is approx. $30,574 (resident) and $62,956 (non-resident) per IU Student Central (studentcentral.indiana.edu). Athletic scholarships plus need- and merit-based institutional/federal/state aid are available; prospective student-athletes should contact IU Student Central and the softball staff for details.
facilities_notes: Indiana softball plays at Andy Mohr Field on the Bloomington campus, a dedicated on-campus softball stadium with fixed seating, press box, and lights. scholarship_count reflects the standard NCAA Division I softball equivalency scholarship limit (12), not a confirmed figure from the IU staff directory.
program_reputation: Big Ten Conference Division I program competing at IU Bloomington. Head coach Shonda Stanton, a member of the National Fastpitch Coaches Association (NFCA) All-America Committee and former member of the NFCA Head Coaches Council, leads the staff.
notes: Coaching staff and contact details captured live from iuhoosiers.com softball coaches/staff directory (checked 2026-07). Roster size (24) counted from the softball roster page player list. No individual coach Twitter/X handles are listed in the staff directory; the team account is @IndianaSB. Head coach email listed as the general softball@iu.edu program address; no separate personal email was published for the head coach. Support staff (athletic trainer, academic services, strategic communications) are shared/multi-sport IU athletics staff assigned to softball among other sports and are included with source notes.
